landing_meta_description: Every series you love, translated into your language, synced across every device.
landing_hero_subtitle: Every series you love, translated into your language, synced across every device — and a sunrise waiting each time you open it.
landing_hero_rating_label: from readers who really should sleep
landing_flaws_title: Reasons to use literally anything else.
landing_flaws_subtitle: Everyone else lists features here. We looked at ours and decided honesty was cheaper.
landing_flaw_broken_body: Half-built, duct-taped, shipped anyway. Every deploy breaks something — usually the login, sometimes the whole shitheap. Nobody tests a damn thing around here. You are the test.
landing_flaw_catalog_body: Ten thousand titles sounds impressive right up until you search for the one you actually came for. It's not fucking here. It won't be here next month either. Go on, check — we'll wait. It's embarrassing for everyone involved.
landing_flaw_kuro_body: No joke: close this shit and go to Kuro Mangas or MangaDex. Bigger library, servers that don't shit themselves hourly, people who actually know what the fuck they're doing. That's not modesty — they're just better than us.
landing_flaw_servers_body: Peak hours are whenever you'd like to read something. Pages crawl in like a fax machine having second thoughts, then a 502 turns up for dessert. It's shit. We know it's shit. We're not fixing it tonight.
landing_flaw_team_body: Two people and a caffeine problem. Your support ticket rots in an inbox we open roughly twice a year, by accident, and immediately close again.
landing_flaw_app_body: No iOS, no Android, no roadmap, no intention. Pinch-zoom on a mobile browser like it's fucking 2009 and tell yourself it builds character.
landing_reviews_subtitle: We asked for honest feedback. We should not have asked.
landing_review_1_quote: this website is a war crime with a login page.
landing_review_2_quote: whoever shipped this should be legally barred from owning a keyboard.
landing_review_2_role: writing this from a dark room
landing_review_3_quote: i have seen ransom notes with better taste and worse intentions.
landing_review_4_quote: opening this is how i found out what despair actually tastes like.
landing_review_5_quote: the single worst thing to happen to manga, and i include the anime adaptations.
landing_review_6_quote: i would rather read a parking meter's terms and conditions. out loud. forever.
landing_cta_body: 10,000 titles and exactly zero reasons to go outside. Make a free account — your first series is already waiting.
landing_footer_tagline: 太陽 — read in the light. Join 20K+ readers who should probably go outside.
